author: The Infographics Show
description:
What actually happens to your body when you ejaculate? You've come to the right place to find out.

This video explores what actually happens during ejaculation, from the sudden rise in heart rate and blood pressure to the flood of dopamine, serotonin, oxytocin, endorphins, and prolactin that affects mood, stress, pain, and sexual drive. We also look at the myths surrounding abstinence and testosterone. Online movements like NoFap have popularized the idea that avoiding ejaculation can dramatically boost testosterone or unlock hidden physical benefits, but the evidence behind those claims is far weaker than many believe. Ejaculation also affects the prostate, nervous system, cardiovascular system, and brain, while excessive sexual behavior can become compulsive and interfere with everyday life. 

The real story isn’t about “losing energy” or storing testosterone, it’s about how many different systems in the human body activate at once during one of its most intense biological response
title: The Brain Shuts Down. The True Cost of Ejaculation.
